Thanks again for the time today — really appreciate the candid rundown of Rowan's use cases and throughput targets. Quick recap and proposed next steps so we can keep momentum: 

Recap (30-min call):
- Primary pilot: in-product summarization and note generation for care managers (targeting 100k tokens/day).
- Success criteria: 30% reduction in manual note time; latency <200ms for interactive flows.
- Compliance constraints: data residency in US, SOC 2 evidence requested, DPIA in scope.

Immediate asks / decisions we need from your side:
1) Budget owner: who holds the budget authority for a potential pilot (name/title and expected budget window)?
2) Economic sponsor: who would sign off on commercial terms if pilot results meet criteria?
3) Procurement & legal contacts for vendor intake and DPA review.

Proposed mutual action plan (MAP):
- This week: confirm budget owner + procurement contact (you indicated Marcus and Priya could be involved)
- Next week: 30-min alignment between Marcus (budget owner), Priya (procurement) and our Solutions lead (Marissa) to go over pricing bands and SOW scope
- Week after: procurement questionnaire + DPA exchange; if green, schedule pilot kickoff the following month

Attachments: post-call-recap.pdf (summary + rough pricing bands).

Would you be able to confirm the two names above (budget owner & economic sponsor) and a good time window for a 30-min alignment next week? If Marcus is the right person, we can copy procurement straight away and draft a short MAP to share with legal.
